shortDescription.text: Tap to fly a courier bird around the world. Every letter lands!
shortDescription.description: Play Store short description, under the screenshots. Friendly, no ALL CAPS, no emoji, no "free"/"best"/"#1" (Play policy).

fullDescription.text:
Beakbound is a bright, offline flying adventure. You are the Sky Club's newest courier: tap to flap, weave through gates, collect stars and deliver the mail across the world.

FLY THE CAMPAIGN
Five mail routes went quiet overnight. Fly level by level from the jungle to carnival Brazil and the Aztec temples, on to ancient Rome, Egypt and Arabia, and into the bright lights of New York. Every level carries a parcel, and every delivery comes back with a thank-you.

FACE THE BOSSES
Baron Bat, the Spitter King, Neferhoo the Mummy Courier, King Coo and the Searchlight Gargoyle stand in the way. Shoot, sprint and dodge to send them packing.

FLY ENDLESS
Chase your best score on the endless course, where gates, gales and bosses keep coming.

MORE TO DO
- Four birds to collect, each with its own voice
- Upgrades bought with the stars you collect
- A daily Adventure and a Sky Passport full of medals
- The Level Builder: make your own routes and fly them
- Fly Together and 1 v 1 duels for two players on one phone
- Mini games that fly by push-ups, squats or jumps in front of the camera

PLAYS YOUR WAY
No account and no internet needed. The camera mini games run entirely on your phone: video never leaves it. Optional Google Play Games cloud save and achievements.
